company.name: Meridian Financial Services
company.description: A fictional company used to simulate a multi-framework compliance audit. All systems, people, risks, and evidence below are invented for testing Secpol end to end.

systems.name: CreditLens Scoring Engine
systems.description: Automated credit-worthiness scoring for personal loan applications.
systems.intended_purpose: Score applicants and produce an approve/refer/decline recommendation.

systems.name: SentinelAML Transaction Monitor
systems.description: Flags potentially suspicious transactions for anti-money-laundering review.
systems.intended_purpose: Detect anomalous transaction patterns and raise SAR candidates.

systems.name: Aria Support Assistant
systems.description: Generative chatbot that answers customer product questions and drafts agent replies.
systems.intended_purpose: Deflect routine support queries and assist human agents.

systems.name: FraudGuard Realtime
systems.description: Real-time card-payment fraud detection at authorization time.
systems.intended_purpose: Approve, challenge, or block card transactions in under 100ms.

risks.name: Proxy discrimination via postcode
risks.description: Postcode and transaction features may act as proxies for protected characteristics, producing disparate decline rates.
risks.mitigation_plan: Run quarterly disparate-impact testing; remove postcode; add fairness constraint.

risks.name: No human review on declines
risks.description: High-risk automated decisions lack a documented human-in-the-loop override path.
risks.mitigation_plan: Implement mandatory human review for all declines above threshold.

risks.name: Alert model drift
risks.description: AML model performance degrades as laundering typologies evolve; false-negative rate rising.
risks.mitigation_plan: Establish monthly backtesting and a drift-monitoring dashboard.

risks.name: Hallucinated product terms
risks.description: Generative assistant may state incorrect fees or terms to customers.
risks.mitigation_plan: Retrieval-grounded responses + disclaimer + confidence-gated escalation. Deployed.

risks.name: Vendor data-sharing exposure
risks.description: Device-intelligence vendor receives payment metadata; DPA scope unverified.
risks.mitigation_plan: Review vendor DPA and data-minimization; confirm sub-processor list.

evidence.name: Q2 disparate-impact test report
evidence.description: Fairness testing across protected groups; two segments flagged for follow-up.

evidence.name: CreditLens technical documentation pack
evidence.description: System architecture, data lineage, and model card per Annex IV.

evidence.name: AML alert monitoring runbook
evidence.description: On-call runbook and logging evidence for alert-pipeline monitoring.

evidence.name: RAG grounding evaluation
evidence.description: Eval showing hallucination rate reduced below 1% on product-terms test set.
